title: Considering lowest possible basal value willst profile reduction
symptom: Cannot set the profile to a lower rate than 100% because at least one basal value is already at the lowest possible value (e.g., 0.05 units on Omnipod DASH), preventing definition of a lower profile for sports.
cause: The profile reduction logic does not consider the pump's minimum basal rate, so it tries to reduce values already at the minimum, causing an error.
fix: No fix was implemented; the issue was closed. Suggested workarounds include preparing an extra profile (not just %) and switching to it, or using diluted insulin.
evidence_quote: I suggest to enhance the logic of profile reduction by considering the lowest possible minimum that the pump is able to handle.
